title: Event (catalogue entry)
description: Definition of a single event that flows on the shared event bus. Events are how capabilities communicate with each other — no capability reads another's data store, but any capability may subscribe to events another capability publishes. Each event has an owning service within an owning capability, a payload schema, and one or more consumers.

name.description: PascalCase, past tense. Events describe things that have happened (e.g. AccountOpened, PaymentSettled, LoanDecided).

source_service.description: The service that publishes this event.

source_capability.description: The capability the publishing service belongs to.

source_entity.description: The entity whose state change the event reports. Optional for events that do not correspond to a single entity change.

trigger.description: What causes the event to be published.

payload_schema.description: The structure of the event payload. Can be an inline JSON Schema or a reference to an external schema.

derived_from.description: Mapping of payload field paths to source-entity field paths, where the event payload is derived from entity state.

consumers.description: Services that subscribe to this event. May include services in other capabilities — that is the permitted cross-capability communication pattern.

topic.description: The bus topic or subject on which the event is published.

worm_audit_pipeline.description: Whether this event must be written to a write-once-read-many audit store for compliance purposes.

retention.description: Retention period for the event and its payload.

cloudevents_type.description: The CloudEvents-compliant type value for this event (reverse-DNS style, e.g. com.acme.capability.entity.event).
